audit.why: 55.12% over 4113 games with FAV / 7.5 difficulty is coherent: Graves owns levels 1-3 on shotgun damage and True Grit armor, Mundo takes over from 4 and never gives it back in a straight fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was internally contradictory and contradicted the packet defect report. phases[4] read 'Graves 3/10' while its own why-text said 'Maximum Dosage makes you nearly unkillable... the lane flips the moment you hit 6'. win[1] said Skill while whys[1] said the level favours him; win[2] said Dr. Mundo while whys[2] said 'Level 3 stays his'.
audit.why: Level 6 is the single clearest Mundo stage in the matchup — a 120s R that heals a percent of missing health against a kit with zero hard CC. Levels 2-3 are Graves's, because his shotgun and Quickdraw's armor beat a Mundo who pays HP for every cleaver.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group: L2 -> Graves (4/10), L3 -> Skill (5/10), L6 -> Dr. Mundo (7/10); whys[2], whys[4] and whys[6] rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves's Q is repeatedly called 'Buckshot' — in spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[3], early, mid and wants.you[0]. There is no ability named Buckshot in his kit: Q is End of the Line, and the shotgun itself is the passive New Destiny. Two decisive interactions were also absent: his passive bullets cannot pass through units, so minions eat his damage, and End of the Line creates terrain that can wall off a Mundo who has no dash.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name is the exact failure class this audit exists to kill, and 'stand in the wave, his bullets don't go through minions' is the single most actionable line in the matchup.
audit.corrected: All Buckshot references replaced with New Destiny / End of the Line / 'his shotgun'; minion-block and terrain-cuts-retreat stated; 'no hard CC to peel you' kept and sharpened.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere — Quickdraw was described only as 'his dash + armor stacks'.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 and refunded by every basic attack that lands, End of the Line is 13s at rank 1, Smoke Screen 26s. Those numbers decide when you step up.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and spikes[0].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mundo has no dash and no escape; nothing warned that End of the Line's terrain is a retreat-cutter.
audit.why: It changes Flash usage: you hold Flash for the wall, not for the damage.

edits.before: Level 3 stays his: full Q plus E True Grit out-trades your early kit.
edits.after: Level 3 is even: Quickdraw's True Grit armor answers your first real trade.

edits.before: Level 6 favours Graves because Smoke Screen into Buckshot bursts you before your ult stabilizes.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Maximum Dosage out-heals his burst and he owns no CC to peel you off.

edits.before: With two-plus items Graves' crit-lethality burst punches through your armor, so he edges the late game.
edits.after: With two-plus items his crit-lethality still stings, but no Graves solo-kills a Warmog's Mundo.

edits.before: Graves' double-shell Q Buckshot plus E True Grit armor makes his all-in scary; wait out his Q, then use E Blunt Force Trauma to stick and Q Infected Bonesaw — but respect that a fed Graves out-DPSs your early bulk.
edits.after: His New Destiny shotgun plus Quickdraw's True Grit armor makes the all-in scary; wait out End of the Line (13s at rank 1), then E Blunt Force Trauma in and Q him — and brawl in the wave, his bullets cannot pass through minions.

edits.before: Your R Maximum Dosage lets you survive his Smoke Screen-Buckshot burst window; heal through it and E onto him, since his kit has no hard CC to peel you off once you're on top.
edits.after: Your R Maximum Dosage survives his Smoke Screen burst window; heal through it and E onto him, because Graves carries no hard CC at all — nothing peels you off once you are on top.

edits.before: Late Graves builds crit-lethality and his auto-Buckshot burst chunks even a tank, so respect his damage in the sidelane and only commit when his Q and E armor are down.
edits.after: Late Graves builds crit-lethality and a reloaded shotgun chunks even a tank, so respect the sidelane and never let End of the Line wall off your retreat — you have no dash to cross it.

edits.before: Graves owns the first three levels — double Buckshot shells plus E True Grit's armor let him out-trade and out-armor you, so farm at range and never walk into a fresh Q with your E on cooldown.
edits.after: Graves owns the first three levels — a loaded New Destiny plus Quickdraw's True Grit armor out-trades you, so farm at range and never step into a fresh End of the Line with your E on cooldown.

edits.before: Level 4 gives you a real window as E Blunt Force Trauma lets you close and Q back, but at 6 he can still burst you with Smoke Screen into Buckshot, so lean on R Maximum Dosage to heal through his combo before sticking.
edits.after: Level 4 gives you a real window as E Blunt Force Trauma lets you close and Q back, and 6 is the hard flip: R Maximum Dosage heals through Smoke Screen and his reload, and nothing in his kit can peel you off once you stick.

edits.before: to bait both Buckshot shells before engaging
edits.after: to bait his shotgun empty before engaging

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Graves Quickdraw (16s at rank 1, refunded by his autos): his dash and armor stacks. Engage when it is down. - End of the Line builds terrain — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Cleaver-slow + run him down.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 but his autos refund it; his bullets cannot pass through minions, so brawl inside the wave.

notes: packet suspectName 'Smoke Screen-' is a FALSE POSITIVE (real ability, prose hyphen). The genuine fabrication was 'Buckshot' used as Graves's Q across six fields — his Q is End of the Line and the shotgun is the passive New Destiny. The packet levelChart itself ([Graves,Graves,Graves,Mundo,Graves,Mundo,Graves]) also disagrees with a 55.12% Mundo win rate and with phases[4].why; I corrected toward the kit and win rate rather than toward the packet chart, so the packet chart may need regenerating.
